newsitem.title: CANADA: Inmet writes down C$355 million.
newsitem.headline: Inmet writes down C$355 million.

text.p: Inmet Mining Corp said on Tuesday it took major writedowns in its third quarter earnings.

The copper, gold and zinc producer posted a third quarter loss of C$361.8 million or C$4.46 per share after a writedown of C$355 million. For the same period of last year, it reported a profit worth C$18.8 million or C$0.22 a share.

The writedown includes C$69 million stemming from the company's decision to stop solution mining at Copper Range in White Pine, Michigan and C$25 million from the shutdown of the Bougrine zinc and lead mine in Tunisia, the company said.
